name: Coast To Kosci Ultramarathon (Cow Bail Trail Route)
description: The Coast to Kosciuszko Ultramarathon route via Cow Bail Trail

points_of_interest.name: Start at Boydtown Beach
points_of_interest.description: Race starts at 05:30 on Friday

points_of_interest.name: Finishing Line
points_of_interest.description: Cut off is at 03:30 on Sunday - 46hrs after start

points_of_interest.name: Nullica River Bridge
points_of_interest.description: Keep to the right of the safety barrier to cross Nullica River Bridge via the footpath

points_of_interest.name: Pacific Hwy Crossing
points_of_interest.description: Cross the highway here after the bridge

points_of_interest.name: Aid Station
points_of_interest.description: At Nullica Rd junction

points_of_interest.name: Runner / Crew Rendezvous Point
points_of_interest.description: Support crews wait for runners here - enjoy breakfast here courtesy of Towamba Public School 😊

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #2 - Rocky Hall
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Rocky Hall Public Telephone on left hand side of road

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #3 - Cathcart
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Cathcart General Store

points_of_interest.name: Monaro Hwy Entry
points_of_interest.description: Run on right hand side of road facing oncoming traffic

points_of_interest.name: Monaro Highway Crossing & Exit
points_of_interest.description: Cross Monaro Highway here

points_of_interest.name: Cattle Grid Crossings
points_of_interest.description: There will be numerous cattle grids situated on next 20 km of route – please take care

points_of_interest.name: Cross Disused Railway Line
points_of_interest.description: Cattle grid crossing on other side

points_of_interest.name: Big Dead Tree
points_of_interest.description: On right hand side on uphill section

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #4 - Gunningrah Rd & Snowy River Way
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: a disused livestock ramp is visible at the intersection

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #5 - Dalgety
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Dalgety Memorial Hall

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #6 - Jindabyne
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Jindabyne Caravan Park Office

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #7 - Perisher Valley
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Perisher Village in bus shelter located right hand side of road, in front of Ski Tube Station

points_of_interest.name: Cut-Off Point #1
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: beyond Dalgety bridge at 06:30 on Saturday - 25hrs since start

points_of_interest.name: Cut-Off Point #2
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: just beyond Jindabyne Caravan Park Office at 14:00 on Saturday - 32:30hrs since start

points_of_interest.name: Cut-Off Point #3
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Charlotte Pass at 23:00 on Saturday - 41:30hrs since start

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #1 - Towamba
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: use building on right hand side when arriving into Towamba

points_of_interest.name: Cow Bail Trail
points_of_interest.description: Only runners and pacers are allowed beyond this point - support crew must u-turn and proceed to Cathcart via New Buildings Rd and Mount Darragh Rd where they can meet up with their runner at Cathcart General Store

points_of_interest.name: Summit of Mt Kosciuszko
points_of_interest.description: Australia's highest point at 2,228m

points_of_interest.name: Mandatory Checkpoint #8 - Charlotte Pass
points_of_interest.description: Landmark: Officials on the right-hand side at the wall

course_points.n: Turn right onto Brandy Creek Trail
Turn right to stay on Towamba Rd
Turn left to stay on Towamba St
Continue onto Big Jack Mountain Rd
Turn left onto Cow Bail Trail
Turn right onto Cow Bail Ft/​Cow Bail Trail
Turn right onto Coolangubra Forest Way
Turn right onto Black Lake Rd
Turn left to stay on Black Lake Rd
Turn left onto Bukalong Siding Rd
Turn left onto The Snowy River Way
Turn right onto The Snowy River Way
At the roundabout, take the 3rd exit
Turn right to stay on Summit Walk
Slight left to stay on Summit Walk
Turn left to stay on Summit Walk
Summit Walk turns slightly left and becomes Kosciuszko Rd
